review:
Big Bass where you pick your bonus. Three or more fish scatters let you choose: classic free spins, or Stack the Cash.

The free spins have modifiers like extra wilds and spins, with four levels and the multiplier rising to 10x. Stack the Cash brings robo-crabs and fish coins instead, with respins every time a fish coin lands and everything collected at the end. Fun detail: the speedboat pays for just two of a kind. 96.5% RTP.
